data.body:
Correction: the residual read-guard gap recorded in this ticket's description points at `beton-inversive-stag`, which is the WRONG ticket — that one is about MCP launch paths bypassing the autodeploy deploy mutex, not about the read guard.

The residual is now tracked properly as **`rapt-dreadable-dromedary`** (`aefe-614a-2631-4117`):
`_reads._tracker` keys on `os.path.isdir`, so a directory that exists but is not a usable store
(no `.git`, unresolvable HEAD, or mid-clone) reads as `[]` rather than `store_uninitialized`.
That ticket carries all three places this has now been hit — the production false-empty, this
ticket's clear-then-failed-clone window, and `unfit-beneficial-whimbrel`'s AC3 — plus the
constraint the fix must respect (an existing but empty INITIALIZED store must still read `[]`).

This ticket's own fix and its verdict are unaffected; only the follow-up pointer was wrong.
